Script for processing ex-situ oxidation data for control microcosm incubations and calculation of oxidation rates (Table S10).

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidylog)
library(ggh4x)

# read modified input and keep rows for kinetics
trace_gas_oxidation_controls <- read_tsv("ex_situ_oxidation_rates_controls.tsv")

# show groups
groups <- distinct(trace_gas_oxidation_controls, group) %>% 
  print

# edit
trace_gas_oxidation_clean <- trace_gas_oxidation_controls %>%
  filter(!is.na(nmol_l), nmol_l > 0) %>% 
   mutate(
    treatment = str_extract(group, "Heat-Killed|Blank"),
    temp      = str_extract(group, "(?<=_)\\d+(?=_)"),
    colour_group = paste0(treatment, "_", temp)
  ) %>% 
    glimpse

# model fitting - first order kinetics (ln-transformed)
lm_controls_raw <- trace_gas_oxidation_clean %>%
  mutate(ln_nmol_l = log(nmol_l)) %>% # for the first order
  group_by(group) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    m <- lm(ln_nmol_l ~ time, data = .x)
    bind_cols(
      broom::tidy(m) %>%
        filter(term == "time") %>%
        select(
          slope = estimate,
          std_error = std.error,
          t_stat = statistic,
          p_value = p.value
        ),
      broom::glance(m) %>%
        select(r_squared = r.squared)
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(group) %>% 
  print

group_levels <- sort(unique(trace_gas_oxidation_controls$group)) %>% 
  print

#write_tsv(distinct(trace_gas_oxidation_controls, group), "distinct_group_controls.tsv")

group_levels <- c(
  "1_Heat-Killed_13_CO", "1_Blank_19_CO", "1_Heat-Killed_19_CO",
  "1_Heat-Killed_13_H2", "1_Blank_19_H2", "1_Heat-Killed_19_H2",
  "1_Heat-Killed_13_CH4", "1_Blank_19_CH4", "1_Heat-Killed_19_CH4",
  "2_Heat-Killed_13_CO", "2_Blank_19_CO", "2_Heat-Killed_19_CO",
  "2_Heat-Killed_13_H2", "2_Blank_19_H2", "2_Heat-Killed_19_H2",
  "2_Heat-Killed_13_CH4", "2_Blank_19_CH4", "2_Heat-Killed_19_CH4"
)

# stripped group_col labels (take from replicate 1 entries, remove "1_" prefix)
group_labels_col_control <- unique(str_remove(group_levels, "^\\d_")) %>%
  setNames(., .) %>%
  str_replace("^.*_(H2|CO|CH4)$", "\\1") %>%       # keep only gas name
  str_replace("H2",  "H₂") %>%
  str_replace("CH4", "CH₄") %>%
  { setNames(., unique(str_remove(group_levels, "^\\d_"))) }

palette_control <- c(
  "Heat-Killed_13" = "#B8E6D6",  # lighter teal-green echoes unwarmed_13
  "Blank_19"       = "#999999",   
  "Heat-Killed_19" = "#FDCAB0"  # lighter orange echoes warmed_19
)

# plot data
plot_data_control <- trace_gas_oxidation_clean %>%
  mutate(
    ln_nmol_l = log(nmol_l),
    rep_row = case_when(
      replicate == 1 ~ "Replicate 1",
      replicate == 2 ~ "Replicate 2"
    ),
    rep_row   = factor(rep_row, levels = c("Replicate 1", "Replicate 2")),
    group     = factor(group, levels = group_levels),
    group_col = str_remove(group, "^\\d_"),
    group_col = factor(group_col, levels = unique(str_remove(group_levels, "^\\d_")))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ln_nmol_l), !is.na(rep_row))

model_data_controls <- lm_controls_raw %>%
  select(group, slope, r2 = r_squared) %>%
  mutate(
    rep_row = case_when(
      str_starts(as.character(group), "1") ~ "Replicate 1",
      str_starts(as.character(group), "2") ~ "Replicate 2"
    ),
    rep_row   = factor(rep_row, levels = c("Replicate 1", "Replicate 2")),
    group_col = str_remove(as.character(group), "^\\d_"),
    group_col = factor(group_col, levels = levels(plot_data_control$group_col))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(rep_row))


# plot
gg_plot_all_control <- plot_data_control %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = ln_nmol_l, colour = colour_group, shape = colour_group)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 4) +
  geom_smooth(
    method    = "lm",
    se        = FALSE,
    colour    = "grey50",
    linewidth = 0.8,
    linetype  = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_text(
     data = model_data_controls,
  aes(x = Inf, y = -Inf,
      label = sprintf("slope = %.3f\nR² = %.3f", slope, r2)),
  hjust = 1.05, vjust = -0.3, size = 3.5, colour = "black",
  inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = palette_control,
    name   = "",
    breaks = names(palette_control),
    labels = c(
      "Heat-Killed_13" = "Unwarmed (heat-killed)",
      "Blank_19"       = "Long-term warmed (Blank)",
      "Heat-Killed_19" = "Long-term warmed (heat-killed)"
    )
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Heat-Killed_13" = 16,   # circle
      "Blank_19"       = 17,    # triangle
      "Heat-Killed_19" = 16   # circle
    ),
    name   = "",
    breaks = names(palette_control),
    labels = c(
      "Heat-Killed_13" = "Unwarmed (heat-killed)",
      "Blank_19"       = "Long-term warmed (Blank)",
      "Heat-Killed_19" = "Long-term warmed (heat-killed)"
      
    )
  ) +
  ggh4x::facet_grid2(
    rep_row ~ group_col,
    scales   = "free_x",
    labeller = labeller(
      group_col = as_labeller(group_labels_col_control),
      rep_row   = label_value
    )
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(3.5, 7)) +
  facetted_pos_scales(
    x = list(
      group_col %in% grep("_CO$",  levels(plot_data_control$group_col), value = TRUE) ~ scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 50)),
      group_col %in% grep("_H2$",  levels(plot_data_control$group_col), value = TRUE) ~ scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 50)),
      group_col %in% grep("_CH4$", levels(plot_data_control$group_col), value = TRUE) ~ scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 500))
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Time [h]",
    y = "Gas concentration [ln(nmol L⁻¹)]"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "darkslategray", size = 13),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(15, "pt"),  # horizontal spacing between facets
    axis.text         = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title        = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.ticks        = element_line(colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.1),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(4, "pt"),
    panel.grid.major  = element_line(colour = "grey96", linewidth = 0.25),
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
    axis.line         = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    legend.position   = "bottom",
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 16)
  )

gg_plot_all_control


```
